listings.title: Seville #17 Hole-in-One Plaque
listings.location: Seville Golf & Country Club · Gilbert, Arizona
description: Seville's island-green par 3, built in layers of wood with a glossy blue water hazard and raised trees.
Each plaque is engraved with the golfer's name, the date of the ace, the yardage and the club. These photos show plaques made for several different aces, including one golfer who has holed it twice.

listings.title: Keller Golf Club #15 Hole-in-One
description: A layered hole-in-one plaque for Keller's 15th, with a deep blue pond, mowing lines on the green and hand-placed trees.
Proof that an ace never gets old. This one went in on August 11, 1988. Any hole at any course can be made the same way, however long ago it happened.
photos: Layered wood hole-in-one plaque of Keller Golf Club hole 15, with a blue pond and raised trees

listings.title: Seville #16 & #17 Plaque
listings.location: Seville Golf & Country Club · Gilbert, Arizona
description: Two of Seville's signature holes on one piece: the short par-4 16th and the island-green 17th.
The surrounding homes and streets are cut and engraved too. It makes a good gift for anyone who lives on the course.
